description: This line plot illustrates the perplexity of three different models—LLaMA-7B, a baseline (orange line), and a baseline with dynamic layerwise pruning (blue line)—as a function of the number of layers, denoted by M, which ranges from 3 to 8 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents perplexity, scaled linearly from 20.0 to 40.0. The LLaMA-7B model (green line with circular markers) shows a slight decrease in perplexity from approximately 28.5 at M=3 to about 27.0 at M=5, followed by a steady increase to roughly 37.0 at M=8. The baseline model (orange line with star markers) exhibits a consistent low perplexity, hovering around 19.0 across all values of M, with a slight dip to approximately 18.5 at M=6. The blue line (with triangle markers) starts at a high perplexity of about 40.0 at M=3, decreases to approximately 34.0 at M=5, and then rises to nearly 40.0 again at M=8, showing a U-shaped trend.
